This is the same pattern as last month, when she stopped raising it for 22 days. THE CALL is still not rebooked 16 days after she agreed to it. On 10-06 she told the client her reel will go out on 23 repost accounts on Monday Oct 12, the first concrete growth deliverable shown in this chat in months. But the client could not see the account list ('I don’t see the accounts') and had to chase with '???' 39 hours later. Melissa re-sent it as a file in 21 minutes, with no confirmation the client can open it. That is the same 'can't open the attachment' problem as the custom brief on 09-18. She has not answered the 09-28 intake form. CHURN WATCH: owner silent 57 days (present). Long-promised Facebook fix with no written proof (present). Billing is 6 of 17 ALTR messages overall, and in the second week it was 4 of the 8 ALTR messages, with nobody from her account team (Mayson, Vivek) posting at all since 09-29 (borderline). Her pace question got a 'Meta is slow' excuse rather than a call offer. Asks are not at zero (2 this window, about 1 a week, vs 0-1 a week in September), and payment was not fast or clean, so the 'paid fast, asked for nothing' exit pattern is not showing yet. No plaintext credentials were posted this window; the August ones are still in the chat.
